title: Is the Music Industry Officially Oversaturated With Songs? | Billboard On The Record
summary: With more than 100,000 songs hitting streaming platforms every day, according to Luminate, is the music industry struggling to keep up? Milana Lewis, cofounder and CEO of Stem, sits down with Billboard On The Record to break down what this fast-growing number of daily uploads means for artists, discoverability and the future of music-making itself.
